verdict.rationale: The RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell is a physical workstation GPU. It exposes no web or service API that an OpenAPI-style spec would describe, so this story is a category error for the product type. Its developer surface is native libraries such as the CUDA Toolkit and SDKs. The NVIDIA inference endpoints on build.nvidia.com are a separate product and do not make this axis apply. Probes of the OpenAPI paths on developer.nvidia.com also all returned 404.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
